title: Two Air Force generals at the Pentagon knew everything

tellings.quote: >> According to Tim, there were two generals at the Pentagon that knew everything.

plain: Two generals at the Pentagon, the US military's headquarters, are said to have known everything about the UFO subject. Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he attracts UFOs and whom the episode describes as studied by NASA, passes this on from a man named Timothy Taylor ("According to Tim, there were two generals at the Pentagon that knew everything"). He gives no names or details, but if true it would mean the full story sits with a few people at the top.
